verdict.rationale: Aider is a local, single-user CLI coding assistant. Nothing in the evidence shows a team-shared workspace that combines docs and repos into a common source of truth. The repo map, adding files or web pages to a chat, and a local .aider.conf.yml all serve one user's session context, which makes them adjacent features rather than the shared-workspace capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
